Here from the feature by the way, huge souls fan but I never had Sony consoles, and thus never played Bloodborne or Demon Souls.

But Dark Souls is beautiful, I think it combines the best of fantasy, in the form of crazy monsters, dragons, knights, magic, etc with a wonderful game system. It has a unique gameplay style, very high difficulty while remaining fair, with some exceptions with dark souls 2 design in my opinion. The world feels amazing, between the music, environments, and even the ambience. It's also one of the most satisfying games I have ever played. The incredible difficulty makes fights like the Nameless King or Gwyn amazing when you finally finish them.

Dark Souls 3 specifically, I had some issues with bonfires, especially ones that were visible from another! However, the weapon skills and unique movesets that resulted from it is amazing. The bosses felt amazing again, price lothric's fight came as a surprise, for example. The final boss was awesome to take out because he felt like an embodiment of the game. The world felt a bit disjointed though, but the areas themselves were great. My only problem with certain bosses were knockdown attacks that had an unavoidable follow up. Exceptions could be made for SoC's combo and similar attacks.

I think it brought a great sequel to the series and is probably my favorite of the three.
Dark Souls III has been out for a few weeks, how do we feel about it and the series as a whole?

I found 3 to be a fitting sendoff to the series both in narrative and in mechanics. The mechanics were polished to a mirror shine, and the environments actually made it feel like everything was going to Hell around you.

It's not as good as the first, but they're gonna have a hard time topping it. I'm just glad it wound up better than 2.
